notes.edge_semantics: Edges are shared-pattern membership or exact same-time same-direction mover co-occurrence; no causal relationship is asserted.
notes.qualification_semantics: Qualified means historical V4.78 statistical/economic gates passed; not a guaranteed trade.
notes.hot_semantics: Hot is a visualization rule only: net>=5%, directional>=80%, holdout_n>=12, q<=0.05. It does not promote a trade.
notes.conflict_semantics: Conflict means a symbol currently has historically qualified RISE and FALL patterns. It is diagnostic, not a trade direction.
notes.write_safety: Publisher reads completed checkpoints only and never mutates Argus research artifacts.
